submission.natural_language_explanation: This pole fires on tokens at the second and later positions of a conventionalized multi-token chunk: fixed collocations and reduplications (question after question, from time to time, speak truth to power, year upon year), name coordinations (News & World, Securities and Exchange, Q&A), and standard number, date, time and rate formats (18-49, 40 events per minute, five days a week, August 14, 13 June, 4:30 p.m., 4,000 years). Firing is driven by the preceding chunk context, not token identity: the same token outside such a frame (to after 'money', after after 'long', '-' after 'numbers 18', '13' after 'bought') activates weakly, while changing only the following word leaves the connector unchanged.
